svg.title: graph-age test environment
svg.desc: Architecture diagram showing graph-age integration test setup with JUnit tests, PostgreSQLAgeServer Testcontainers launcher, HikariCP connectionInitSql, Exposed Database.connect, and Apache AGE container runtime.
svg.text: Integration tests share the AGE container launcher, build a HikariCP DataSource, then bind Exposed to the AGE-ready connection pool.
Every test DataSource must run LOAD 'age' and set ag_catalog in connectionInitSql before Exposed transactions execute AGE SQL.
